taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Identity-Aware Proxy assertion validation and origin reachability
controls.source_trace: Trace a verified IAP assertion into application identity, including issuer/audience and whether direct origin requests can supply equivalent unverified headers.
controls.implementation_branch: Check the signed IAP assertion and its exact protected-resource audience; email/identity headers alone may be forgeable on a direct backend path. Determine whether network/ingress restrictions actually prevent that path before declaring bypass. A legitimate request through IAP is a positive control, not proof that all origin routes validate the assertion.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned proxy/backend fixture; compare intended IAP request and direct synthetic identity-header input.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An email header name or unreachable origin is not authentication bypass; verify a protected synthetic response under the forged identity.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Validate assertions and origin ingress consistently, preserving authorized proxy traffic and rejecting direct impersonation.
